description: Nine-solid GN 3971 aluminum-housing bevel gear box assembly covering all seven catalog sizes and both L/T shaft arrangements. Official external envelopes, keyed shaft ends, and mounting interfaces are table-driven; two equal 45-degree straight-bevel approximations share one pitch-cone apex and move at the documented 1:1 ratio. Hidden tooth count, bearing width, internal cavity, fits, and minor edge details are documented proportions.
source: Ganter GN 3971 standard sheet pages 1-3 and product page; DIN 6885-1 keyway reference; documented proportion rules for unpublished internals
